jp: \t\t紐の先端を金属で強化した戦闘用の鞭。もともと鞭は致命傷よりも苦痛を与えるための道具であるが、強化によって骨程度は砕く威力を得た。ピシリという音は先端速度が音速に達して空気を叩いた音であり、物体に当たって生じる音とは異なる。\n#～明日から使えるあなたの為の武具集～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t紐の先端を金属で強化した戦闘用の鞭。もともと鞭は致命傷よりも苦痛を与えるための道具であるが、強化によって骨程度は砕く威力を得た。ピシリという音は先端速度が音速に達して空気を叩いた音であり、物体に当たって生じる音とは異なる。\n#～明日から使えるあなたの為の武具集～\n"
en: A combat whip with the tip of the cord reinforced with metal. Originally, the whip was designed to inflict pain rather than fatal injury, but the strengthening of the whip has given it the power to shatter bones. The sound of the tip reaching the speed of sound and striking the air is different from the sound produced when it strikes an object. \n# ~Collection of Armaments you can Use Tomorrow~
en_grezzo: "A combat whip with the tip of the cord reinforced with metal. Originally, the whip was designed to inflict pain rather than fatal injury, but the strengthening of the whip has given it the power to shatter bones. The sound of the tip reaching the speed of sound and striking the air is different from the sound produced when it strikes an object. \n# ~Collection of Armaments you can Use Tomorrow~"
it: Una frusta da combattimento, con la punta della corda rinforzata di metallo. In origine la frusta era un arnese per dare dolore più che per uccidere, ma il rinforzo le ha dato la forza di spezzare almeno le ossa. Lo schiocco è il rumore della punta che raggiunge la velocità del suono e batte l'aria: non è il rumore che fa quando colpisce qualcosa. \n# ~Raccolta di Armi e Armature da Usare Domani~

jp: \t\t武器としても使えるように専門家が設計したという、頑丈な造りの靴下。砂やコインを入れて思い切り振り回しても形が崩れない一級品。目が細かすぎて蒸れやすく臭いも染みつきやすいのが欠点。\n#～明日から使えるあなたの為の武具集～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t武器としても使えるように専門家が設計したという、頑丈な造りの靴下。砂やコインを入れて思い切り振り回しても形が崩れない一級品。目が細かすぎて蒸れやすく臭いも染みつきやすいのが欠点。\n#～明日から使えるあなたの為の武具集～\n"
en: A sock with a sturdy construction, designed by experts to be used as a weapon. It is a first-class product that does not lose its shape even when filled with sand or coins and swung around as much as possible. The disadvantage is that they are too fine-grained, making them susceptible to moisture and odors. \n# ~Collection of Armaments you can Use Tomorrow~
en_grezzo: "A sock with a sturdy construction, designed by experts to be used as a weapon. It is a first-class product that does not lose its shape even when filled with sand or coins and swung around as much as possible. The disadvantage is that they are too fine-grained, making them susceptible to moisture and odors. \n# ~Collection of Armaments you can Use Tomorrow~"
it: Un calzino di fattura robusta che, dicono, un esperto ha disegnato perché servisse anche da arma. È roba di prima qualità: riempilo di sabbia o di monete e giralo con tutta la forza, non perde la forma. Il difetto è che la trama è troppo fitta, quindi dentro si suda e l'odore ci si attacca. \n# ~Raccolta di Armi e Armature da Usare Domani~

jp: \t\t農耕具である鎌を発展させた護身武器。鎖で攻撃した際の反動によって鎌の刃で手を怪我しないよう、護拳がついてる。鎖で動きを鈍らせてから接近し鎌部分で攻撃するのが一般的。\n#～明日から使えるあなたの為の武具集～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t農耕具である鎌を発展させた護身武器。鎖で攻撃した際の反動によって鎌の刃で手を怪我しないよう、護拳がついてる。鎖で動きを鈍らせてから接近し鎌部分で攻撃するのが一般的。\n#～明日から使えるあなたの為の武具集～\n"
en: A self-defense weapon developed from the scythe, a farming tool. It is common to use the chain to slow down the attacker's movement before approaching and attacking with the sickle. \n# ~Collection of Armaments you can Use Tomorrow~
en_grezzo: "A self-defense weapon developed from the scythe, a farming tool. It is common to use the chain to slow down the attacker's movement before approaching and attacking with the sickle. \n# ~Collection of Armaments you can Use Tomorrow~"
it: Un'arma da difesa nata dalla falce, che è un attrezzo da campo. Ha una guardia sul manico perché il contraccolpo del colpo di catena non ti faccia ferire la mano sulla lama. Di solito si rallenta il nemico con la catena, poi ci si avvicina e si colpisce con la falce. \n# ~Raccolta di Armi e Armature da Usare Domani~

jp: \t\tその昔、破壊の神が癒しの女神を襲撃した際、守護者がその身を盾に破壊の一撃から女神を守り通した。身体をズタズタにされながらも攻撃を受け止め女神に傷一つつけなかった守護者に破壊の神は感服し、この武器を授けて去って行ったという。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\tその昔、破壊の神が癒しの女神を襲撃した際、守護者がその身を盾に破壊の一撃から女神を守り通した。身体をズタズタにされながらも攻撃を受け止め女神に傷一つつけなかった守護者に破壊の神は感服し、この武器を授けて去って行ったという。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n"
en: Once upon a time, when the God of Destruction assaulted the Goddess of Healing, the guardian protected the Goddess from the destructive blow by using his own body as a shield. The God of Destruction was so impressed by the guardian, who was able to withstand the attack even though his body was shredded, that he gave him this weapon and left. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~
en_grezzo: "Once upon a time, when the God of Destruction assaulted the Goddess of Healing, the guardian protected the Goddess from the destructive blow by using his own body as a shield. The God of Destruction was so impressed by the guardian, who was able to withstand the attack even though his body was shredded, that he gave him this weapon and left. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~"
it: Tanto tempo fa, quando il dio della distruzione assalì la dea della guarigione, il guardiano fece scudo del proprio corpo e la difese fino in fondo dal colpo. Resse l'attacco pur essendo ridotto a brandelli, e alla dea non toccò un graffio; il dio della distruzione ne fu ammirato, gli lasciò quest'arma e se ne andò. \n# ~Dizionario Fantastico di Irva~

jp: \t\t「攻撃と防御は表裏一体。守る物があるのなら相応の力を持つべきだ」\n#～破壊の神の言葉～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t「攻撃と防御は表裏一体。守る物があるのなら相応の力を持つべきだ」\n#～破壊の神の言葉～\n"
en: \"Offense and defense are two sides of the same coin. If you have something to defend, you should have the strength to do so.\" \n# ~words of a God of Destruction~
en_grezzo: "\"Offense and defense are two sides of the same coin. If you have something to defend, you should have the strength to do so.\" \n# ~words of a God of Destruction~"
it: \"Attacco e difesa sono le due facce della stessa cosa. Se hai qualcosa da proteggere, devi avere la forza che ci vuole.\" \n# ~Parole del Dio della Distruzione~

jp: \t\t刀状の巨大な高周波ブレード。元々は個人用の武器だったが取り回しが難しく、開き直った開発主任がより巨大化させ大型兵器用にしたという経緯がある。余剰熱を火炎弾に転換し炸裂させる様子は、まるで種を放つホウセンカのよう。なお、この再現機能が原因で重量がさらに増している。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t刀状の巨大な高周波ブレード。元々は個人用の武器だったが取り回しが難しく、開き直った開発主任がより巨大化させ大型兵器用にしたという経緯がある。余剰熱を火炎弾に転換し炸裂させる様子は、まるで種を放つホウセンカのよう。なお、この再現機能が原因で重量がさらに増している。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n"
en: A huge, katana-shaped, high-frequency blade. Originally intended as a personal weapon, it was difficult to handle, so the chief developer decided to make it even larger and more powerful. The excess heat is converted into a flaming projectile, which explodes like a rose balsam. The weight of the sword has been further increased to produce this effect. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~
en_grezzo: "A huge, katana-shaped, high-frequency blade. Originally intended as a personal weapon, it was difficult to handle, so the chief developer decided to make it even larger and more powerful. The excess heat is converted into a flaming projectile, which explodes like a rose balsam. The weight of the sword has been further increased to produce this effect. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~"
it: Una lama enorme ad alta frequenza, a forma di katana. In origine era un'arma per un uomo solo, ma era difficile da maneggiare; allora il capo dello sviluppo, non sapendo più che pesci pigliare, la fece ancora più grande e la destinò alle armi pesanti. Quando converte il calore in eccesso in proiettili di fuoco e li fa scoppiare, pare una balsamina che sputa i semi. E per via di questo effetto pesa ancora di più. \n# ~Dizionario Fantastico di Irva~

jp: \t\t収束したアストラル光が刃となっている鎌。骨のような節の部分から分離して多節鞭のような形状にもなり、柔軟な斬撃が可能。断ち切られた輪廻、永遠の安息を象徴する。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t収束したアストラル光が刃となっている鎌。骨のような節の部分から分離して多節鞭のような形状にもなり、柔軟な斬撃が可能。断ち切られた輪廻、永遠の安息を象徴する。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n"
en: A scythe whose blade is made of converged astral light. It can be separated from the bone-like section to form a multi-sectioned whip-like shape, allowing for flexible slashing. It symbolizes the severed samsara, eternal rest. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~
en_grezzo: "A scythe whose blade is made of converged astral light. It can be separated from the bone-like section to form a multi-sectioned whip-like shape, allowing for flexible slashing. It symbolizes the severed samsara, eternal rest. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~"
it: Una falce la cui lama è luce astrale raccolta in un fascio. Si separa in corrispondenza dei nodi, che paiono ossa, e prende la forma di una frusta a più sezioni: così il colpo diventa flessibile. È il simbolo del ciclo delle rinascite spezzato, del riposo eterno. \n# ~Dizionario Fantastico di Irva~

jp: \t\t代々叡智を司る神に伝えられてきた杖。世界中で起きていることを一瞬のうちに知覚し記録する力を持つが、極めて限られた一部の神にしか扱えない。かつて失われた常闇の眼とも関わりが深い。\n#～叡智の書～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t代々叡智を司る神に伝えられてきた杖。世界中で起きていることを一瞬のうちに知覚し記録する力を持つが、極めて限られた一部の神にしか扱えない。かつて失われた常闇の眼とも関わりが深い。\n#～叡智の書～\n"
en: This staff has been handed down from generation to generation to the Gods of Wisdom. It has the power to perceive and record what is happening around the world in an instant, but can only be used by a very limited number of deities. It is also closely related to the Origin of Vice that was once lost. \n# ~Book of Wisdom~
en_grezzo: "This staff has been handed down from generation to generation to the Gods of Wisdom. It has the power to perceive and record what is happening around the world in an instant, but can only be used by a very limited number of deities. It is also closely related to the Origin of Vice that was once lost. \n# ~Book of Wisdom~"
it: Un bastone tramandato di generazione in generazione fra gli dei che presiedono alla sapienza. Ha il potere di percepire e registrare in un istante quel che accade in tutto il mondo, ma solo pochissimi dei sanno usarlo. Ha molto a che fare anche con l'occhio delle tenebre eterne, perduto tanto tempo fa. \n# ~Il Libro della Sapienza~

jp: \t\t重力を操る力を秘めた手斧。斬りつけた相手を重力の球の中へ閉じ込めて押しつぶす。重力の加わった斬撃自体も重い。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t重力を操る力を秘めた手斧。斬りつけた相手を重力の球の中へ閉じ込めて押しつぶす。重力の加わった斬撃自体も重い。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n"
en: A hatchet with the power to manipulate gravity. It crushes a slashed opponent by trapping him in a ball of gravity. The slash itself is also heavy with added gravity. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~
en_grezzo: "A hatchet with the power to manipulate gravity. It crushes a slashed opponent by trapping him in a ball of gravity. The slash itself is also heavy with added gravity. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~"
it: Un'accetta che racchiude il potere di comandare la gravità. Chiude chi ha colpito dentro una sfera di gravità e lo schiaccia. E anche il colpo in sé, con la gravità addosso, è pesante. \n# ~Dizionario Fantastico di Irva~

jp: \t\t亜竜族の力を秘めた棒状の武器。棒であるため他の武器と比べて特に破壊力が高いわけではない。だが扱いやすさは優秀で、高速でテクニカルな攻撃を繰り出せる。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t亜竜族の力を秘めた棒状の武器。棒であるため他の武器と比べて特に破壊力が高いわけではない。だが扱いやすさは優秀で、高速でテクニカルな攻撃を繰り出せる。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n"
en: A staff-shaped weapon that holds the power of the drake race. Because it is a staff, it is not particularly destructive compared to other weapons. However, it is easy to handle and can be used to make fast, technical strikes. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~
en_grezzo: "A staff-shaped weapon that holds the power of the drake race. Because it is a staff, it is not particularly destructive compared to other weapons. However, it is easy to handle and can be used to make fast, technical strikes. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~"
it: Un'arma a forma di bastone che racchiude la forza della stirpe dei draco. Essendo un bastone non ha una potenza distruttiva particolare, se la confronti con altre armi. Ma si maneggia benissimo, e permette attacchi rapidi e di tecnica. \n# ~Dizionario Fantastico di Irva~

jp: \t\t月から回収されたとされる石を発振器に用いて作られた、美しい光の長剣。生み出された余剰エネルギーを光の波動に変換する。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t月から回収されたとされる石を発振器に用いて作られた、美しい光の長剣。生み出された余剰エネルギーを光の波動に変換する。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n"
en: A beautiful long sword of light made from a stone said to have been recovered from the moon and used as an oscillator. The surplus energy produced is converted into waves of light. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~
en_grezzo: "A beautiful long sword of light made from a stone said to have been recovered from the moon and used as an oscillator. The surplus energy produced is converted into waves of light. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~"
it: Una bella spada lunga di luce, fatta usando come oscillatore una pietra che, si dice, viene dalla luna. L'energia in eccesso che produce la converte in onde di luce. \n# ~Dizionario Fantastico di Irva~

jp: \t\t黒いユニコーンの角でできた槍。表面の螺旋に沿って混沌の力が渦巻き、敵対するものを抉り貫く。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t黒いユニコーンの角でできた槍。表面の螺旋に沿って混沌の力が渦巻き、敵対するものを抉り貫く。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n"
en: Lance made of the horn of a black unicorn. The power of chaos swirls along the spiral of its surface, gouging through anything that opposes it. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~
en_grezzo: "Lance made of the horn of a black unicorn. The power of chaos swirls along the spiral of its surface, gouging through anything that opposes it. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~"
it: Una lancia fatta con il corno di un unicorno nero. Lungo la spirale della superficie vortica la forza del caos, che scava e passa da parte a parte chi le si oppone. \n# ~Dizionario Fantastico di Irva~

jp: \t\t神の火の中から生まれたとされる大剣。聖なる炎をその刀身に宿し、汚れた不死者を焼き尽くし浄化する。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t神の火の中から生まれたとされる大剣。聖なる炎をその刀身に宿し、汚れた不死者を焼き尽くし浄化する。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n"
en: Greatsword said to have been born from the fire of God. With holy fire in its blade, it burns and purifies the defiled immortals. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~
en_grezzo: "Greatsword said to have been born from the fire of God. With holy fire in its blade, it burns and purifies the defiled immortals. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~"
it: Uno spadone che, si dice, nacque dentro il fuoco di un dio. Porta nella lama una fiamma sacra, e i non morti corrotti li brucia fino in fondo e li purifica. \n# ~Dizionario Fantastico di Irva~

jp: \t\t品種改良に失敗して生まれた。無駄に強度があり武器として使えるほか、先端部には栄養が豊富に含まれているため一本で二度おいしい。なぜか、持っているだけでクリティカルが出やすくなる。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t品種改良に失敗して生まれた。無駄に強度があり武器として使えるほか、先端部には栄養が豊富に含まれているため一本で二度おいしい。なぜか、持っているだけでクリティカルが出やすくなる。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n"
en: It was born from a failed cultivating attempt. In addition to being uselessly durable like a weapon, the tip is rich in nutrients, making it twice as beneficial as a weapon in one. For some reason, just holding it makes it easier to get a critical hit. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~
en_grezzo: "It was born from a failed cultivating attempt. In addition to being uselessly durable like a weapon, the tip is rich in nutrients, making it twice as beneficial as a weapon in one. For some reason, just holding it makes it easier to get a critical hit. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~"
it: È nato da un incrocio andato male. Ha una durezza che non gli serve a niente, e per questo si usa da arma; e visto che la punta è piena di sostanze nutrienti, uno solo è buono due volte. Chissà perché, a tenerlo in mano vengono più colpi critici. \n# ~Dizionario Fantastico di Irva~

jp: \t\t自らの身体能力を犠牲にして魔法力を大幅に増幅する杖。幾千もの魔術士の命と引き換えにようやく討伐されたとされる、伝説の魔獣の骨とその眼球を用いて作られた。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t自らの身体能力を犠牲にして魔法力を大幅に増幅する杖。幾千もの魔術士の命と引き換えにようやく討伐されたとされる、伝説の魔獣の骨とその眼球を用いて作られた。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n"
en: A staff that greatly amplifies magical power at the expense of one's own physical abilities. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~
en_grezzo: "A staff that greatly amplifies magical power at the expense of one's own physical abilities. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~"
it: Un bastone che sacrifica le doti fisiche di chi lo porta per aumentare di molto la forza magica. È fatto con le ossa e gli occhi di una bestia magica leggendaria che, si dice, fu abbattuta a fatica al prezzo di migliaia di vite di maghi. \n# ~Dizionario Fantastico di Irva~

jp: \t\tなんということでしょう。伝説の楽器が匠の手により鈍器へと生まれ変わりました。その贅沢さは楽器の価値がわかる者ならば卒倒するほど。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\tなんということでしょう。伝説の楽器が匠の手により鈍器へと生まれ変わりました。その贅沢さは楽器の価値がわかる者ならば卒倒するほど。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n"
en: What a surprise! Legendary musical instrument, transformed into a blunt weapon by the hands of a master craftsman. The extravagance of the instrument is enough to make anyone who understands the value of musical instruments swoon. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~
en_grezzo: "What a surprise! Legendary musical instrument, transformed into a blunt weapon by the hands of a master craftsman. The extravagance of the instrument is enough to make anyone who understands the value of musical instruments swoon. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~"
it: Ma guarda un po' che roba. Uno strumento leggendario, per mano di un maestro artigiano, è rinato come arma contundente. Uno sfarzo tale che chi capisce il valore degli strumenti sviene sul posto. \n# ~Dizionario Fantastico di Irva~

jp: \t\t巨大な本。神をもってしても読破できないほど分厚い。人では振るえない程の重さだが、使いこなす者が現れた時この武器は使用者にとてつもない学習能力を授けるだろう。それと少しばかりの気まぐれを。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t巨大な本。神をもってしても読破できないほど分厚い。人では振るえない程の重さだが、使いこなす者が現れた時この武器は使用者にとてつもない学習能力を授けるだろう。それと少しばかりの気まぐれを。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n"
en: A huge book. It is so thick that even a God couldn't read it. It is so heavy that it cannot be wielded by a human being, but when a person comes along who knows how to use it, this weapon will give the user tremendous learning ability. And a little whimsy. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~
en_grezzo: "A huge book. It is so thick that even a God couldn't read it. It is so heavy that it cannot be wielded by a human being, but when a person comes along who knows how to use it, this weapon will give the user tremendous learning ability. And a little whimsy. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~"
it: Un libro enorme. Così spesso che nemmeno un dio riuscirebbe a leggerlo tutto. È di un peso che un uomo non regge, ma quando comparirà chi sa servirsene, quest'arma gli donerà una capacità di apprendimento smisurata. E, insieme, un pizzico di capriccio. \n# ~Dizionario Fantastico di Irva~

jp: \t\t刀身から無限に毒薬が染み出す妖刀。忍者秘伝の物であり、詳細を知る者はほとんどいない。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t刀身から無限に毒薬が染み出す妖刀。忍者秘伝の物であり、詳細を知る者はほとんどいない。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n"
en: A demon sword that seeps an endless supply of poison from its blade. It is a secret of the ninja, and few people know the details. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~
en_grezzo: "A demon sword that seeps an endless supply of poison from its blade. It is a secret of the ninja, and few people know the details. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~"
it: Una lama maledetta dalla quale il veleno trasuda senza fine. È un segreto dei ninja, e quasi nessuno ne conosce i particolari. \n# ~Dizionario Fantastico di Irva~

jp: \t\t癒しの神の護身用アイテム。相手を傷つけずに取り押さえるためのもの。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t癒しの神の護身用アイテム。相手を傷つけずに取り押さえるためのもの。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n"
en: Self-defense item of the Goddess of Healing. It is used to seize an opponent without harming him. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~
en_grezzo: "Self-defense item of the Goddess of Healing. It is used to seize an opponent without harming him. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~"
it: L'oggetto con cui la dea della guarigione si difende. Serve a bloccare qualcuno senza fargli male. \n# ~Dizionario Fantastico di Irva~

jp: \t\t太陽神の子が光を結晶化して生み出したスティック。剣のように見え、実際に剣のような使い方もするがあくまでも長棒である。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t太陽神の子が光を結晶化して生み出したスティック。剣のように見え、実際に剣のような使い方もするがあくまでも長棒である。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n"
en: A staff created by the son of the sun God by crystallizing light. It looks like a sword and can actually be used like a sword, but it is only a long staff. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~
en_grezzo: "A staff created by the son of the sun God by crystallizing light. It looks like a sword and can actually be used like a sword, but it is only a long staff. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~"
it: Un bastoncino che il figlio del dio del sole ha ricavato facendo cristallo della luce. Sembra una spada, e in effetti si usa anche come una spada, ma resta comunque un bastone lungo. \n# ~Dizionario Fantastico di Irva~

jp: \t\t邪を祓う為に更に強大な邪を用いる、という考えから生み出された黒の剣。これには兄弟ともいうべく剣が存在し、それぞれを両手に握れば世界ですら破壊し得る程の力を得るのだという。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t邪を祓う為に更に強大な邪を用いる、という考えから生み出された黒の剣。これには兄弟ともいうべく剣が存在し、それぞれを両手に握れば世界ですら破壊し得る程の力を得るのだという。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n"
en: A black sword, surrounded with an aura of dread, was created from the idea of using an even more powerful evil to exorcise evil. It is rumored that there are a counterpart sword, and that if each is held in both hands, they can become so powerful that they can destroy even the world. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~
en_grezzo: "A black sword, surrounded with an aura of dread, was created from the idea of using an even more powerful evil to exorcise evil. It is rumored that there are a counterpart sword, and that if each is held in both hands, they can become so powerful that they can destroy even the world. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~"
it: Una spada nera, nata dall'idea di usare un male ancora più grande per scacciare il male. Ne esiste una che si potrebbe dire sua gemella, e dicono che, a stringerle tutt'e due, una per mano, si ottenga una forza capace di distruggere perfino il mondo. \n# ~Dizionario Fantastico di Irva~

jp: \t\t安楽死させるための巨大な十字剣。死をもってしか癒せないものもある。人では振るえない程の重さだが、使いこなす者が現れた時この武器は使用者に固い意志を授けるだろう。それと少しばかりの気まぐれを。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t安楽死させるための巨大な十字剣。死をもってしか癒せないものもある。人では振るえない程の重さだが、使いこなす者が現れた時この武器は使用者に固い意志を授けるだろう。それと少しばかりの気まぐれを。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n"
en: Giant crossed swords designed for euthanasia. Some things can only be healed through death. It is so heavy that no man can wield it, but when someone comes along who knows how to use it, this weapon will give the user a firm will. And a little whimsy. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~
en_grezzo: "Giant crossed swords designed for euthanasia. Some things can only be healed through death. It is so heavy that no man can wield it, but when someone comes along who knows how to use it, this weapon will give the user a firm will. And a little whimsy. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~"
it: Una spada a croce, enorme, fatta per dare una morte dolce. Ci sono cose che solo la morte può guarire. È di un peso che un uomo non regge, ma quando comparirà chi sa servirsene, quest'arma gli donerà una volontà ferma. E, insieme, un pizzico di capriccio. \n# ~Dizionario Fantastico di Irva~

jp: \t\t全てを破壊する巨大な戦斧。人では振るえない程の重さだが、使いこなす者が現れた時この武器は使用者にとてつもないパワーを授けるだろう。それと少しばかりの気まぐれを。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t全てを破壊する巨大な戦斧。人では振るえない程の重さだが、使いこなす者が現れた時この武器は使用者にとてつもないパワーを授けるだろう。それと少しばかりの気まぐれを。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n"
en: A huge battle axe that destroys everything. It is so heavy that it cannot be wielded by a single person, but when a person finds a way to master it, this weapon will give the user tremendous strength. And a little whimsy. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~
en_grezzo: "A huge battle axe that destroys everything. It is so heavy that it cannot be wielded by a single person, but when a person finds a way to master it, this weapon will give the user tremendous strength. And a little whimsy. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~"
it: Un'ascia da battaglia enorme, che distrugge ogni cosa. È di un peso che un uomo non regge, ma quando comparirà chi sa servirsene, quest'arma gli donerà una forza smisurata. E, insieme, un pizzico di capriccio. \n# ~Dizionario Fantastico di Irva~

jp: \t\t巨大な地底獣の骨を加工して作られた鎌。人では振るえない程の重さだが、使いこなす者が現れた時この武器は使用者に果てしない耐久力を授けるだろう。それと少しばかりの気まぐれを。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t巨大な地底獣の骨を加工して作られた鎌。人では振るえない程の重さだが、使いこなす者が現れた時この武器は使用者に果てしない耐久力を授けるだろう。それと少しばかりの気まぐれを。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n"
en: Scythe made from the bones of a huge subterranean beast. It is too heavy for a man to wield, but when a master emerges, this weapon will give the user boundless constitution. And a little whimsy. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~
en_grezzo: "Scythe made from the bones of a huge subterranean beast. It is too heavy for a man to wield, but when a master emerges, this weapon will give the user boundless constitution. And a little whimsy. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~"
it: Una falce ricavata dalle ossa di una bestia sotterranea gigantesca. È di un peso che un uomo non regge, ma quando comparirà chi sa servirsene, quest'arma gli donerà una costituzione senza fine. E, insieme, un pizzico di capriccio. \n# ~Dizionario Fantastico di Irva~

jp: \t\t愛と怒りと悲しみがこもる包丁。次々と敵の首を切り落とすその切れ味は、見るものに椿の花がボトボトと落ちる様子を連想させる。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t愛と怒りと悲しみがこもる包丁。次々と敵の首を切り落とすその切れ味は、見るものに椿の花がボトボトと落ちる様子を連想させる。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n"
en: Kitchen knife filled with love, anger, and sorrow. The sharpness with which it cuts off the heads of enemies one after another reminds the viewer of a camellia flower falling in droplets. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~
en_grezzo: "Kitchen knife filled with love, anger, and sorrow. The sharpness with which it cuts off the heads of enemies one after another reminds the viewer of a camellia flower falling in droplets. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~"
it: Un coltello da cucina in cui stanno chiusi amore, rabbia e dolore. Taglia via una testa dopo l'altra, e a vederlo viene in mente il fiore della camelia che cade a terra tutto intero, uno dietro l'altro. \n# ~Dizionario Fantastico di Irva~

jp: \t\t「ねぇ…どいてよ。どいてくれないとそいつ殺せないでしょ？泥棒猫さんにはひとのものを取るとどうなるのか、ちゃんと教えてあげないと…だからそいつを庇うのはやめて…お願い。じゃないと、私…！」\n#～迫り来る妹の言葉～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t「ねぇ…どいてよ。どいてくれないとそいつ殺せないでしょ？泥棒猫さんにはひとのものを取るとどうなるのか、ちゃんと教えてあげないと…だからそいつを庇うのはやめて…お願い。じゃないと、私…！」\n#～迫り来る妹の言葉～\n"
en: \"Hey...get out of the way. If you don't get out of my way, I can't kill her, can I? I have to teach that thieving pussy cat what happens when you stole something that belongs to someone else...so please don't protect her...please. Otherwise, I...!\" \n# ~words of a younger sister~
en_grezzo: "\"Hey...get out of the way. If you don't get out of my way, I can't kill her, can I? I have to teach that thieving pussy cat what happens when you stole something that belongs to someone else...so please don't protect her...please. Otherwise, I...!\" \n# ~words of a younger sister~"
it: \"Senti... spostati. Se non ti sposti non posso ammazzarla, no? A quella ladra bisogna pure insegnarglielo, che cosa succede a prendersi la roba degli altri... quindi smettila di difenderla... ti prego. Se no io...!\" \n# ~Parole della Sorella Minore che si Fa Sotto~

jp: \t\t海賊の汚名を着せられたヒーローが使っていたサーベル。皮肉なことに現在は本物の賊の手に渡ってしまっている。振るうと力が湧いてくる。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t海賊の汚名を着せられたヒーローが使っていたサーベル。皮肉なことに現在は本物の賊の手に渡ってしまっている。振るうと力が湧いてくる。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n"
en: Saber used by a hero who was stigmatized as a pirate. Ironically, it is now in the hands of real pirates. When swung, it produces a shockwave of power. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~
en_grezzo: "Saber used by a hero who was stigmatized as a pirate. Ironically, it is now in the hands of real pirates. When swung, it produces a shockwave of power. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~"
it: La sciabola che usava un eroe a cui avevano affibbiato il marchio di pirata. Per ironia della sorte, adesso è finita in mano a dei banditi veri. A girarla, ti monta dentro la forza. \n# ~Dizionario Fantastico di Irva~

jp: \t\t凄まじい切れ味を持つチェーンソー。神すらもバラバラにしかねない。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t凄まじい切れ味を持つチェーンソー。神すらもバラバラにしかねない。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n"
en: Chainsaw with tremendous cutting power. It can even dismember God. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~
en_grezzo: "Chainsaw with tremendous cutting power. It can even dismember God. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~"
it: Una motosega che taglia in modo spaventoso. Potrebbe fare a pezzi perfino un dio. \n# ~Dizionario Fantastico di Irva~

jp: \t\t帯電した杭状の槍を射突して対象を殺傷する武器。非常に扱いづらく、こんなものを好き好んで使うのは重度のマニ信者かロマンチストくらいであろう。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t帯電した杭状の槍を射突して対象を殺傷する武器。非常に扱いづらく、こんなものを好き好んで使うのは重度のマニ信者かロマンチストくらいであろう。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n"
en: An electrified stake-shaped shooting spear. It is very difficult to handle, and only a serious Mani-devotee or maniac would like to use such a weapon. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~
en_grezzo: "An electrified stake-shaped shooting spear. It is very difficult to handle, and only a serious Mani-devotee or maniac would like to use such a weapon. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~"
it: Un'arma che uccide sparando in avanti una lancia a forma di palo, carica di elettricità. È scomodissima da usare, e a sceglierla di gusto ci sarà solo un fedele accanito di Mani o un romantico. \n# ~Dizionario Fantastico di Irva~

jp: \t\t巨大な大剣。あまりに大きく、分厚く、重く、大雑把で、もはや剣というよりは鉄塊といったほうが適切である。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t巨大な大剣。あまりに大きく、分厚く、重く、大雑把で、もはや剣というよりは鉄塊といったほうが適切である。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n"
en: A huge sword. It is so large, thick, heavy, and rough that it is more appropriate to call it a lump of iron than a sword. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~
en_grezzo: "A huge sword. It is so large, thick, heavy, and rough that it is more appropriate to call it a lump of iron than a sword. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~"
it: Uno spadone enorme. È talmente grande, spesso, pesante e rozzo che chiamarlo blocco di ferro è più giusto che chiamarlo spada. \n# ~Dizionario Fantastico di Irva~

jp: \t\t食材を捌く為に用いられる小型の短刀。本来の用途は家庭用だが刃はしっかり研がれている為、戦闘に使うこともできるだろう。\n#～料理を支える脇役達～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t食材を捌く為に用いられる小型の短刀。本来の用途は家庭用だが刃はしっかり研がれている為、戦闘に使うこともできるだろう。\n#～料理を支える脇役達～\n"
en: Small dagger used to handle foodstuffs. Its original purpose is for household use, but since the blade is well sharpened, it may be used in battle. \n# ~Supporting Roles in Kitchen~
en_grezzo: "Small dagger used to handle foodstuffs. Its original purpose is for household use, but since the blade is well sharpened, it may be used in battle. \n# ~Supporting Roles in Kitchen~"
it: Un coltellino corto che serve a preparare quel che si mangia. L'uso per cui è fatto è quello di casa, ma la lama è affilata per bene, quindi si potrà usare anche per combattere. \n# ~I Comprimari della Cucina~

jp: \t\t燦然と光り輝く刀身を持つ異様な長剣。製法は全くの不明だが、聞くところによると異世界の騎士が一人前になる際に、自らの力を示す為一人で作り上げるのだという。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t燦然と光り輝く刀身を持つ異様な長剣。製法は全くの不明だが、聞くところによると異世界の騎士が一人前になる際に、自らの力を示す為一人で作り上げるのだという。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n"
en: A strange long sword with a brilliantly shining blade. The method of making it is completely unknown, but according to rumors, knights in other worlds make it by themselves to show their power when they become full-fledged knights. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~
en_grezzo: "A strange long sword with a brilliantly shining blade. The method of making it is completely unknown, but according to rumors, knights in other worlds make it by themselves to show their power when they become full-fledged knights. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~"
it: Una spada lunga fuori dall'ordinario, con la lama che splende di luce viva. Come si faccia non si sa proprio, ma a quel che si dice i cavalieri di un altro mondo, quando diventano adulti, se la costruiscono da soli per mostrare quanto valgono. \n# ~Dizionario Fantastico di Irva~

jp: \t\t竜を撃退する為に作られた特殊な刀剣。その刀身は鮮血に濡れているかの如く怪しく光り、電撃を生じる程の鋭い一撃で、日夜竜を屠っているのだという。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t竜を撃退する為に作られた特殊な刀剣。その刀身は鮮血に濡れているかの如く怪しく光り、電撃を生じる程の鋭い一撃で、日夜竜を屠っているのだという。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n"
en: Special sword made to repel dragons. Its blade glows mysteriously as if it is drenched in fresh blood, and it is said that it slaughters dragons day and night with blows so sharp that they produce electric shocks. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~
en_grezzo: "Special sword made to repel dragons. Its blade glows mysteriously as if it is drenched in fresh blood, and it is said that it slaughters dragons day and night with blows so sharp that they produce electric shocks. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~"
it: Una lama speciale, fatta per respingere i draghi. Il suo acciaio luccica in modo inquietante, come fosse bagnato di sangue fresco, e dicono che notte e giorno faccia strage di draghi con colpi tanto affilati da produrre scariche elettriche. \n# ~Dizionario Fantastico di Irva~

jp: \t\t巨大な猫の尻尾の彫像、と見紛う程の杖。人では振るえない程の重さだが、使いこなす者が現れた時この武器は使用者に比類なき魔力を授けるだろう。それと少しばかりの気まぐれを。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t巨大な猫の尻尾の彫像、と見紛う程の杖。人では振るえない程の重さだが、使いこなす者が現れた時この武器は使用者に比類なき魔力を授けるだろう。それと少しばかりの気まぐれを。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n"
en: The staff is so large that it could be mistaken for a statue of a giant cat's tail. It is too heavy for a man to wield, but if one were to master it, this weapon would bestow unparalleled magical power upon its wielder. And a little whimsy. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~
en_grezzo: "The staff is so large that it could be mistaken for a statue of a giant cat's tail. It is too heavy for a man to wield, but if one were to master it, this weapon would bestow unparalleled magical power upon its wielder. And a little whimsy. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~"
it: Un bastone talmente grande da scambiarlo per la statua della coda di un gatto gigantesco. È di un peso che un uomo non regge, ma quando comparirà chi sa servirsene, quest'arma gli donerà una magia senza pari. E, insieme, un pizzico di capriccio. \n# ~Dizionario Fantastico di Irva~

jp: \t\t柄の長い大きな鎌。刃は鎌より湾曲していないが、柄を両手で掴み、勢いよく振るうことで敵の戦意と部位を刈り取っていくという。\n#～明日から使えるあなたの為の武具集～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t柄の長い大きな鎌。刃は鎌より湾曲していないが、柄を両手で掴み、勢いよく振るうことで敵の戦意と部位を刈り取っていくという。\n#～明日から使えるあなたの為の武具集～\n"
en: A large scythe with a long handle. The blade is less curved than a sickle, but by grasping the handle with both hands and swinging it vigorously, it is said to reap the battle spirit and body parts of the enemy. \n# ~Collection of Armaments you can Use Tomorrow~
en_grezzo: "A large scythe with a long handle. The blade is less curved than a sickle, but by grasping the handle with both hands and swinging it vigorously, it is said to reap the battle spirit and body parts of the enemy. \n# ~Collection of Armaments you can Use Tomorrow~"
it: Una falce grande, dal manico lungo. La lama è meno ricurva di quella di un falcetto, ma dicono che, afferrando il manico a due mani e girandolo con slancio, si mietono insieme la voglia di combattere del nemico e i pezzi del suo corpo. \n# ~Raccolta di Armi e Armature da Usare Domani~
